verdicts.reason: Candidate A has a sensible left-to-right banner order. Its flaws: the SOLSTICE wordmark floats off-axis above and left of the headline, and the 'Summer Only' badge is split off to the right while 'Back by Demand' is stacked over the CTA, leaving the two badges ungrouped and the far right dead. The body copy is also tiny. Candidate B has the same split badges and dead right side, plus worse problems: SOLSTICE butts straight into the headline so it reads 'SOLSTICECucumber', the phone is jammed against the top and bottom edges, and there is a big empty gap between the phone and the text.
